blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police are investigating a shooting incident reported in Barangay Tabon-Tabon, Baco, Oriental Mindoro, early Friday, Oct. 16. The Baco Municipal Police Station said it received a call from a concerned citizen reporting the incident and immediately dispatched personnel to verify the report and respond to the scene.
